operating_notes.text: Hariom Power and Energy Private Limited was incorporated on March 19, 2025, for developing and operating a 60 MW solar power plant project.
Re-appointed M/s. R Kabra & Co, LLP as statutory auditors for a second 5-year term.
Value-added products accounted for 96% of total sales volume in FY26.
Subsidiary Hariom Power and Energy commissioned two 5 MW (AC) solar plants at Jaipur and Pusegaon, Hingoli, Maharashtra, under MSKVY 2.0.
Group commissioned solar capacity rose to 15 MW (AC) after the two plants.
Entered into a non-binding MoU with APEDB for a proposed ₹700 crore investment to set up an integrated steel plant at D. Hirehal, Anantapur District, Andhra Pradesh.

timeline.summary: Hariom Pipe filed its annual promoter share encumbrance disclosure under Regulation 31(4) showing zero pledges for FY26.
Hariom Pipe invested ₹10.00 crore in its subsidiary Hariom Power and Energy to support its 60 MW solar power plant project.
Hariom Pipe Board approved issuing up to 15,00,000 warrants at ₹343 each aggregating ₹51.45 crore to promoters on a preferential basis.
Hariom Pipe released its Q4 and FY26 investor presentation detailing a 23% increase in FY26 revenue and setting a 30% volume growth target for FY27.
Hariom Pipe Industries Limited uploaded the audio recording of its May 23, 2026, investor conference call discussing Q4FY26 and FY26 results at 3:00 PM IST.
Hariom Pipe hosted its Q4FY26 earnings call discussing financial performance, solar power project execution, and volume growth plans.
Hariom Power and Energy, a subsidiary of Hariom Pipe Industries, commissioned two 5 MW (AC) solar plants in Hingoli, Maharashtra, taking group solar capacity to 15 MW (AC).
Hariom Pipe signed a non-binding MoU with APEDB on October 23, 2026, for a proposed ₹700 crore investment to establish an integrated steel plant at D. Hirehal, Andhra Pradesh.
